theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fm := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq : ∀ k : Fin 2, (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fm k).val = y := by
    intro k
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fm k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fm k))).symm
  have hd : (fm 1).val = (fm 0).val + 1 := by
    have h := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y
    have h0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have h1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
    dsimp only at h
    simp only [fm, h, h0, h1, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β,
      zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    exact add_comm _ _
  have hsp : ∀ k : Fin 2, P_i.eval (fm k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fm k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    intro k
    simp only [P_i, P₀, P₁, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs,
      Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have hfold : f_i_plus_1 y
      = P_i.eval (fm 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (fm 1).val - r_chal)
        + P_i.eval (fm 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fm 0).val) := rfl
  have hpoly : P_i_plus_1 = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact rfl
  rw [hfold, hsp 0, hsp 1, hpoly, hd]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring
